name: skill-router
description: File-aware skill auto-routing: a PostToolUse hook injects one additionalContext directive to load the relevant best-practice skill(s) when you edit a matching file (PHP/Laravel/Blade, React/Vue/Inertia via .tsx/.jsx/.vue, plain .ts/.js/.py/.go/.rb/.rs, SQL and migrations (one engine-agnostic rubric, plus a MariaDB row where that engine is detected), components, tests, Dockerfiles, OpenAPI), a SessionStart hook primes a repo-tailored skill index, and low-confidence content signals flush as one digest on your next prompt (SessionEnd keeps the ledger). Every relevant skill co-fires per edit; fail-open, once per skill per session.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

cc_route.title: Prompt tool-fit check (CC_ROUTE)
cc_route.description: Hand the model command-picking rules and flush pending low-confidence skill signals: on or off. The environment variable CC_ROUTE overrides this.

cc_subagent_skills.title: Subagent skill paths (CC_SUBAGENT_SKILLS)
cc_subagent_skills.description: Hand a plugin subagent the paths of the best-practice skills its frontmatter declares: on or off. The environment variable CC_SUBAGENT_SKILLS overrides this.

cc_surfaced_log.title: Surfaced-signal ledger (CC_SURFACED_LOG)
cc_surfaced_log.description: Append the session's surfaced routing signals to a machine-local ledger at session end: on or off. The environment variable CC_SURFACED_LOG overrides this.

cc_route_scope.title: Stack-scoped skill listing (CC_ROUTE_SCOPE)
cc_route_scope.description: Drop the Laravel, Inertia, Next.js, Vite, React Native, Tailwind, shadcn and MariaDB skills from the skill listing when this repository shows no evidence of that stack; their names stay as one line and the Skill tool still loads them: on or off. The environment variable CC_ROUTE_SCOPE overrides this.

cc_compact_steer.title: Steer compaction to keep pipeline state (CC_COMPACT_STEER)
cc_compact_steer.description: When a phase sentinel, task-runner run or taskmaster ledger is on disk, tell the compaction summarizer to keep the phase, run, card in progress, scope lock and done list: on or off. The environment variable CC_COMPACT_STEER overrides this.
